entries.title: Proverbs 8:1
segments: Does not wisdom call? And does not understanding put forth her voice?

entries.title: Proverbs 8:2
segments: She stands in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the path.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:3
segments: She cries in the gates, before the entrance of the city, [at] the doors.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:4
segments: To you, O men, I call; and my voice [is] to the sons of man.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:5
segments: O simple ones understand wisdom; and, fools, be of an understanding heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:6
segments: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips [shall be] right things.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:7
segments: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness [is] hateful to my lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:8
segments: All the words of my mouth [are] in righteousness; nothing twisted or perverse [is] in them.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:9
segments: They [are] all plain to him who understands, and right to those who find knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:10
segments: Receive my instruction and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:11
segments: For wisdom [is] better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:12
segments: I, wisdom, dwell with sense, and find out knowledge of discretions.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:13
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] to hate evil; I hate pride, and arrogance, and the evil way, and the wicked mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:14
segments: Counsel and sound wisdom [are] Mine; I [am] understanding; I have strength.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:15
segments: By Me kings reign and princes decree justice.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:16
segments: Princes rule by Me, and nobles, all the judges of the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:17
segments: I love those who love Me; and those who seek Me early shall find Me.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:18
segments: Riches and honor [are] with Me; enduring riches and righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:19
segments: My fruit [is] better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and what I give [is better than] choice silver.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:20
segments: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:21
segments: I may cause those who love Me to inherit riches; and I will fill their treasuries.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:22
segments: The LORD possessed Me in the beginning of His way, before His works of old.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:23
segments: I was anointed from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth [ever was].

entries.title: Proverbs 8:24
segments: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when [there were] no springs heavy [with] water.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:25
segments: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I travailed;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:26
segments: before He had made the earth, or the fields or the highest part of the dust of the world.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:27
segments: When He prepared the heavens, I [was] there; when He set a circle upon the face of the deep;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:28
segments: when He set the clouds above; when He made the strong fountains of the deep;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:29
segments: when He gave to the sea its limit that the waters should not pass His command; when He appointed the foundations of the earth;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:30
segments: and I was a workman at His side; and I was daily [His] delight, rejoicing always before Him;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:31
segments: rejoicing in the world, His earth; and My delight [was] with the sons of men.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:32
segments: And now listen to Me, O sons; for blessed [are those who] keep My ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:33
segments: Hear instruction, and be wise, and do not refuse it.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:34
segments: Blessed [is] the man who hears Me, watching daily at My gates, waiting at the posts of My doors.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:35
segments: For whoever finds Me finds life, and shall obtain favor from the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:36
segments: But he who sins against Me wrongs his own soul; all who hate Me love death.
